text: Mechanics is a fundamental discipline that studies the laws of mechanical motion of matter. It aims to explore the relationship between force, motion and deformation, and solve mechanical problems in engineering and science through mathematical modeling and experimental analysis. As a bridge between physics and engineering, mechanics encompasses both theoretical research (such as classical mechanics and quantum mechanics) and engineering applications (such as structural mechanics and fluid mechanics), and it serves as the core foundation in fields like aerospace, machinery, civil engineering, and materials science.
